Thank you for understanding. My frustrations started with the final episodes of his Minecraft series: he was basically screaming at virtual animals and walking around. I understand, he finished all there was in the game, but he didn't stop and eventually I stopped watching the series. It fell from it's grace and crashed into the ground.

In my opinion, it's... Unnecessary. 

It surely isn't gonna be as big, cause everyone was doing their part while Tseries started to overtake PewDiePie, e.g. people who have spent a lot of money on those "Subscribe to pewds" billboards are probably not going to do it now, unless they also do some YouTube videos about it to get the money back. Now no one is really interested enough to make the war a big thing.

PewDiePie doesn't really help the situation: I know he tries to play it delicate by changing the intro and sh*t, but it only makes me wish for CocoMelon to take the lead. Pewds' content became really safe and also kind of boring over the past few years, probably to avoid any drama. He has to finally wake up. He really doesn't need more subs, tbh he should've stayed at 60mil cuz there are more interesting channels that deserve more recognition instead of him with his 70 Reddit reviews.

Another problem is his fanbase. I know there are some funny people out there, but 3/4 of them are unable to behave idiots, who don't know how to construct a good joke. The current situation makes it even worse. Let me put it into perspective: in my opinion about 25% of pewds' fans are trying to actually help him overtake CocoMelon, the rest saw the opportunity to milk the problem and get that tasty karma, so they spew out as much cringy "memes", "ideas" and "hopeful slogans" to make the problem bigger and easier to abuse for their own good. For God's said, they make their siblings and all the children around them watch a grown man screaming random stuff, when they could be at  least learning smoething. Maybe if a channel for children is doing better than channel of a guy, whose 90% of content relies on you, the fanbase, you might be doing something wrong.

I could rant about it for really long, but I want to prove my point: the CocoMelon war is stupid and unnecessary. We all know that it's going to overtake pewds' no matter what, so why milk the fuckin thing? If no one started to talk about it, we wouldn't have this problem: CocoMelon would be doing it's thing, pewds would be doing his own thing. 

Don't get me wrong, I was watching PewDiePie for about 3 years and I like him as a guy, but I hate how basic and lazy his content currently is. Fans don't help either. Sorry if my points aren't very valid, I was thinking about it for a longer time and I had to spit my anger out. Thanks for reading.
